column1: # Carry register (ADR-0041): every path the fork may change relative to the
# upstream pin, other than a theme-hook file the hook registry
# (.agents/skills/po-theme/surfaces.tsv) owns. One tab-separated row per claim:
#   match     path (the row names one repository path exactly) or regex (an
#             extended regular expression that must match the whole path; for
#   path      the repository path, or the expression
#   owner     ADR-NNNN, the accepted decision that claims it, or fix, a bug-fix
#             carry that needs no ADR of its own
#   retire    sync (the carry retires at the upstream synchronization that brings
#             an equivalent change: the merge takes upstream's version and drops
#             the row) or decision (the row stands while its ADR stands)
#   upstream  the https:// link to the upstream issue or pull request that offers
#             the change, or - when none is known
#   note      what the row carries; required for a fix row, which no ADR explains
# A path several decisions touch has one row per owner, so each carry retires on
# its own. A fix row names one exact path, retires at sync, and has a note.
# Where an accepted ADR says the A4 allowlist drops a path, the merge drops that
# bin/po-carries.sh reads this file for gate A4, and gate A9 accepts a fix row's
# changed lines in a theme-hook file; its header owns the checks.
